subject: Re: BrightPath pilot — extension options (flat month vs burst pack)
messages:
From: Elaine Sun <elaine@brightpath.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request — options?

Hi Marissa,

Quick one — our pilot with Redwood is wrapping Friday but engineering still needs ~3 weeks to finish the final integration tests. We can stretch the current trial, but finance wants a clear pricing option rather than open-ended credits.

Can you propose a short, billable bridge we can sign quickly? Two things we discussed internally:
- A flat monthly add-on (one calendar month at a flat rate, includes same SLA and support)
- A burst-pack of token-hours that we draw down as needed (cheaper if we use little; risk if we spike)

We need cost and impact on SLA, and whether the same Dedicated capacity can be held for the month. Also, any paperwork needed to avoid a pause in the sandbox? We can sign a quick amendment if the terms are straightforward.

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Sun
Head of ML Ops, BrightPath
elaine@brightpath.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — options?

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clarity.

We can offer two clean paths so finance has a simple decision:

Option A — Flat month (recommended for predictability)
- One-month addendum priced at $18,000 USD (same Dedicated capacity profile, SLA maintained)
- Includes 24/7 support during the month and one priority engineering sync
- Auto-expire at month end; no commitments beyond the month

Option B — Burst pack (token-hours block)
- 200k token-burst pack for $12,000 USD (drawdown model)
- Capacity held best-effort; if BrightPath needs strict capacity reservation, add $2k to reserve a burst slot
- More cost-efficient for light usage, less predictable if you spike

I also put Kim and David on cc for billing/legal signoff. I’ll draft a one-page amendment once you indicate preference.

Which direction does finance lean toward? I can have a signed DocuSign by EOD tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Quick internal note:

Marissa — good numbers. A couple small tweaks I’d recommend before we send the amendment to the customer:
1) For Option A (flat month) offer a 10% trial-extension discount if they’ve stayed within the agreed usage band — call it $16,200 net — this keeps sticker higher but gives a clear concession.
2) For Option B (burst pack) add a 30-day expiry on unused tokens (we don’t want long tail credits).
3) Add a line: "Reserved capacity guarantee subject to a single optional confirmation run 48 hours prior to start; failure to confirm may trigger best-effort fallback." Keeps us covered operationally.

David — can you confirm the above is fine from a legal/finance perspective and whether we can streamline approval for signatures under $25k? If yes, we’ll send the amendment with DocuSign link and the pricing comparison worksheet.

Kim

kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Hi Elaine — attaching a one-page amendment and a short pricing comparison. Per our internal note, we proposed:

- Flat month (Option A): $16,200 (10% concession) — reserved Dedicated capacity, SLA preserved
- Burst pack (Option B): 200k tokens for $12,000; unused tokens expire after 30 days
- Reserved capacity confirmation clause included (48-hour confirmation window)

We also added a one-line clause allowing one expedited signature path for deals under $25k to avoid procurement delays.

Attachments: BrightPath_Pilot_Amendment_20270318.pdf; pilot-pricing-comparison-20270318.xlsx

If Option A is easiest for your finance team, reply with approval and we’ll send a DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Marissa
